params.text:
I found the PyTorch-GAN project which is a comprehensive collection of PyTorch implementations of Generative Adversarial Networks. This repository contains implementations of many GAN variants including ACGAN, Adversarial Autoencoder, BEGAN, BicycleGAN, Conditional GAN, CycleGAN, DCGAN, InfoGAN, WGAN, and many more.

The project has 45 stars, 193 commits, and is MIT licensed. While the repository has gone stale according to the maintainer, it remains a valuable collection of GAN implementations.

SSH clone command: ssh://git@172.26.116.102:2222/eriklindernoren/PyTorch-GAN.git

To clone the repository, use:
```bash
git clone ssh://git@172.26.116.102:2222/eriklindernoren/PyTorch-GAN.git
```

Note: You need to add an SSH key to your GitLab profile to use SSH cloning. Alternatively, you can use HTTPS cloning as shown in the README:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/eriklindernoren/PyTorch-GAN
cd PyTorch-GAN/
sudo pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```
